ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly high-intensity white pixels occupying approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zone extending across both lobes; low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edge boundary and distal tips; a vertical cluster of low-intensity pixel blobs is located at the proximal central region near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 10-15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge transition to irregular, jagged high-amplitude peaks at the distal tips; the left lobe edge exhibits a smoother linear boundary than the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical sigmoid curve trajectory; lobes exhibit slight concavity immediately lateral to the median notch, transitioning to broad convexity towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of 6-8 distinct low-intensity circular pixel groups located at the central fluke base; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters are visible on the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey-scale linear disruptions observed mid-lobe on the left side, trending roughly parallel to the leading edge trajectory.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular texture cluster on the right distal tip representing barnacle colonization; visible jagged interruption of the trailing edge contour on the far right extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive dark 'mottling' constellation forming a rough Y-shape at the peduncle-fluke interface.
